༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi

bkra shis brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang bshes gnyen tshul/ /mtha' yas 'gro la phan bde'i dge legs stsol/ /lā li ta sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ / srid zhi'i phun tshogs ma lus 'dir stsol cig /mi 'gyur bde chen chos dbyings rnam dag las/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thugs/ /bdud dpung kun 'joms 'jigs mdzad chen po'i skur/ /ston mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon pos bkra shis shog /bde chen g.yo med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /mos pa sna tshogs sems can 'dul ba'i phyir/ /ye shes nyams brgya'i sprul pa sna tshogs 'chang*/ /rigs lnga'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bkra shis shog /mtha' dag rgyal ba dgyes pa'i zlos gar mkhan/ /zag med bde bskyed sgyu 'phrul du mas sgeg/ rjes chags rol pas rnam rgyan lha mo'i gtso/ /rtsa rtsi ka sogs lha mos bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor kun tu sngags kyi lha rnams kun/ /dgug gzhugs bcing dang mnyes pas las mdzad cing*/ /bgegs kun 'joms mdzad dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /sgo srung khro bo rnams kyis bkra shis shog /gzugs sgra la sogs 'dod yon lha mo rnams/ /phung po nyon mongs 'chi bdag lha yi bu/ /'phrin las drag po 'dul phyir sku sprul pa/ /bde skyong thod pa bzhi yis bkra shis shog / dbang po bcas pa'i lha dang nad gdon sogs/ /gdugs can 'dul phyir 'jigs byed skur bzhengs pa/ /dpag yas rgyal ba sras bcas kun 'dus dngos/ /zhe dgu'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis shog /gdugs pa skrag byed rdo rje ro langs brgyad/ /mthar byed lus 'dzin phyogs bcu'i dgra bgegs 'dul/ /sgrub la dngos grub gnyis kyis mchog stsol ba/ /sgo mtshams gnas pa rnams kyis bkra shis shog /bcu drug 'pho ba'i bag chags mthar 'dzin pa/ / bde chen ye shes ma gshin bcu drug tshul/ /thog med 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mthu dpal can/

/las mdzad pho nya'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog /byang chub phyogs chos rang bzhin rgyan gyis spras/ /rdo rje sa gzhi 'dam skyes lte bar gnas/ /srid las sgrol phyir dur khrod chen por bcas/ /ye shes gzhal med khang gis bkra shis shog /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i gur/ /rwa ba me dpung 'bar ba 'khor lo bcas/ /bar chad kun 'joms srung ba'i 'khor lo yis/ /srid gsum phan bde khyab pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/ sa skyong gzhon nu kun dga' bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bskul nas/ /tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //dge'o// tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - 159-- 153 -- PAGE 152 -
